# Code of conduct

This project is a place to build things together. Everyone who takes
part, in issues, discussions, pull requests and reviews, is expected to:

- treat other people with respect, whatever their background, experience
  or opinion;
- argue about the work, not the person, and accept that a decision may
  go another way;
- keep private information private, and never harass, threaten or
  demean anyone.

Behaviour that falls short can be reported to the maintainers at
legal@cernanto.com. Reports are read promptly and handled in
confidence. The maintainers may edit or remove contributions, and
exclude people who repeatedly break these rules, from the project's
spaces.
